notes: Built from scratch: imports/lore/_clusters.json did not exist. 276 roster slugs in 41 clusters of 4 to 9, every slug in exactly one.

The graph's nine-person groups were largely re-cut: several joined unrelated people through name-key collisions (Adalric to Hieronymus, Vethraun to the Ossuary Choir) or through migration-note stat comparisons (Gorrath to Karasaki, Cernan, Sinclair and Zarron). Those edges are not in-world ties and were not used.

Possible same persons kept together: ziyu-pip-inari with ziyu-pip-inari-the-two-tailed-cipher (c32); xanelor-rafiminar with xanelor-rafminar-the-wandering-fang (c05). Kaalabad and Kirishima Hae-jin, whose folk name is Kaalabad, are also kept together (c04); placing them together does not settle whether they are one person.

Cross-cluster ties the writers must honour: Yukizumi Yukari (c06) is Yukari by blood (c14); Borin Ironheart (c02) is Ymir Rhok's mentor (c16); Kwon Mu-jin (c09) shares his Kujo-arc scenes with Kaalabad (c04) and is father to Lily, Hiromi and Geturo (c05); Sodoku (c03) is Hild's father (c01) and Rikudoku's (c05); Sevrin (c32) and Karo Venrik (c10) are bound as informant and handler; Goraku (c18) drinks with Vaelthyr (c32); Maeron (c30) names Serenyra (c39); Serenyra (c39) handed the Grove-Spired throne to the Venrik line (c10, Isaac 2026-09-13); Azure Serathiel (c03) is the absent hub of c26; Maerion (c08) and Severin (c06) carry many scenes in the North and Curia threads; Gorrum (c15) appears in two scenes of Hild's coalition; Malphas (c35) is lord of the Rot Host (c23); Deimos (c22) is named on most of the Reaper office's cards (c06).

Malphas placed with his cell rather than his generals: his own card names neither, and The Night's Watch, his one archived scene, puts him with the cell. The Night's Watch cast is split by side: the Night Register (c34) and the cell (c35).
Azure Serathiel kept at Kharven (c03) because his archived scenes put him in the Tenrai council's argument over Muken; his card's own ties (Ambrose, Emilia, Evangelien, Vaelen) sit in c26 and c10.

Card-level conflicts already recorded on the cards and left open: Kaelzar's (c16) and Rik'Lye's (c39) cards name a Niran who is not canon's Niran Yukari; Ignatius's card says Voyager Era while the scenes write Darius in the present; WORLD.md lists Babyl (c24) and the name Onawa Ashkewe (c11) among struck names. Placement settles none of them.

Shared surnames without a textual tie were not treated as kinship: Draen and Lumen Varos (c16, c30), Rhaevan and Azure Serathiel (c26, c03), Eira and Lucen Vale (both c07). Zahir and Vaerath Ashveil share a cluster (c27) without their cards naming each other.

Clusters that rest wholly or partly on order, place, era or kind rather than on cards naming each other (the fallback for groups of one or two): c12, c13, c17, c18, c19, c20, c21, c24, c25, c26, c28, c29, c30, c31, c33, c36, c37, c40, c41. Their hinges say which.
Point-of-view and record cards: Sodoku Moto (record) is in c03; Hild Ice and Robin Ice (pov) in c01; Kwon Mu-jin (pov) in c09.
